<thought>Based on the mass‑spectrometry data, the most intense ion is at m/z ≈ 199, which is consistent with a protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. The neutral mass is therefore about 198 Da. A plausible formula that matches this mass and contains only C, H, O (and no other elements) is C₁₀H₁₄O₄.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H14O4</final_answer>
